author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Algeria severed diplomatic relations with the United Arab Emirates on Thursday, an abrupt rupture between two Arab governments whose ties had been strained for years.

The Algerian government cited what it called provocative and hostile actions but did not specify the conduct behind the decision. It said efforts to preserve the relationship had been exhausted. Algerian media have previously accused the UAE of trying to sow discord, adding to an increasingly public dispute.

The UAE responded that it hoped the break would be temporary and said it remained committed to relations based on shared interests. The statement left open the possibility of future diplomatic engagement but did not announce a mediation effort or timeline.

Ending formal relations can affect ambassadorial representation and routine government coordination, though neither side immediately detailed the practical measures that would follow. The lack of a specific allegation from Algiers also leaves the immediate trigger unclear. Further statements will determine whether the decision expands into broader restrictions or remains a diplomatic protest.
dek: Algiers cited unspecified hostile actions, while the UAE said it hoped the rupture would be temporary.
headline: Algeria cuts diplomatic ties with United Arab Emirates
